summary: Example task runs show version on IOS-XR with iosxr_command.
questions: How do I get the IOS-XR version with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Get IOS-XR version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve IOS-XR version
  cisco.iosxr.iosxr_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'cisco.iosxr.iosxr'
```
